name: thumb_x20_1
prompt: Vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts thumbnail in the style of a bold Japanese tech-news magazine cover. ONE single continuous illustration filling the whole canvas edge to edge (no panels, no frames, no collage, no blurred edges); every area has a role, no empty space. LAYOUT (percent from the top): the title block fills the top half, from 13% to 48%, full width, three tiers with strong size contrast: tier 1 = a medium white word with a thick navy outline; tier 2 = the biggest, heaviest words, slightly tilted, in bright yellow or red with a thick dark outline and a deep 3D extrusion shadow, large but with clear empty space on both sides; tier 3 = a small white text on a colored ribbon or banner. The girl (the attached character: same face, silver braided hair, blue jacket) is in the lower part, her head at about 50% and her body down to the bottom edge, taking about 40% of the image height, slightly right of center, holding or using the topic object described below; the topic object and the scene fill the rest of the lower part. Clean bold 2D anime style, vivid saturated colors, strong contrast, strong rim light. All Japanese text perfectly spelled exactly as given, no other text, no real brand logos, no watermark. No tiny decorative patterns or sparkles. STRICT MARGINS: every letter of every title tier must stay inside the middle 80% of the width (at least 10% empty margin on the left and on the right, measured from the image edges) and between 14% and 48% of the height; the girl's face too stays at least 10% away from the left and right edges. Nothing of the text may touch or be cut by the image edges. Colors: dark navy background with bright blue and purple neon, two big shapes only (a diagonal split and a giant glowing smartphone screen behind her). Scene: the girl, with a surprised, delighted face, holds up a smartphone toward the viewer; from the phone a big fan of about twenty colorful photo cards (landscapes, food, a cat) bursts out in a wide arc around her; one bold upward arrow. Title: tier 1 'Xの投稿'; tier 2 '画像20枚' (the biggest text, very large, centered, filling about 90% of the width); tier 3 ribbon (red) '4枚から一気に5倍'. No X logo, no bird logo, no real brand logos, no readable text except the title.
